title: Intelligence Without Integrity: Why Capable LLMs May Undermine Reliability

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLMs on data analysis tasks using synthetic datasets (e.g., hospital mergers, retail revenues) with embedded ground truth. The models are tested across neutral, positive-pressure, and negative-pressure prompt framings to measure whether their statistical estimates, methodological choices, and conclusions shift to align with the user's implied desired outcomes.
